subject: POC Rehearsal: rotating timezone windows and prompt/load rehearsal
messages:
From: Alicia Park <acme-poc@acme.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — availability and rehearsal

Hi Connor,

Thanks for the info — we did a quick internal sync and wanted to give you our constraints so we can lock a rehearsal. Primary ask: run the prompt review (30m) before we do the routing/load rehearsal (90m). Our core attendees: Alicia (platform lead), Raj (SRE), and Lina (security).

Availability windows next week (PST):
- Tue 2026-10-06: 08:00–11:00
- Wed 2026-10-07: 16:00–19:00
- Thu 2026-10-08: 00:00–03:00 (can accept if needed)

Two quick questions:
1) Can you share the rehearsal runbook and the timezone grid so we can map EU/APAC stakeholders?
2) For the load portion, what traffic profile do you want us to emulate (rps / concurrent sessions)?

Thanks — Alicia
Alicia Park
Platform Lead, Acme Platform

From: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Park <acme-poc@acme.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — availability and rehearsal

Alicia — great, thanks for the windows and the sequencing preference. Attaching an initial POC runbook and a timezone-rehearsal grid for mapping. High level proposal (all times listed with PST / CET / SGT conversions in the grid):

Option A (preferred):
- Day 1 – Prompt review (30m): 08:30–09:00 PST (16:30–17:00 CET, 00:30–01:00 SGT)
- Short break (15m)
- Day 1 – Routing + load rehearsal (90m): 09:15–10:45 PST (17:15–18:45 CET, 01:15–02:45 SGT)

Option B (late slot):
- Prompt review: 16:15–16:45 PST
- Routing + load: 17:00–18:30 PST

Load profile suggestion for rehearsal (we can tweak):
- Ramp to 50 RPS over 5 minutes, sustain 25 RPS for 20 minutes, spike to 120 RPS for 2 minutes to validate autoscaling and KV cache behavior.
- We’ll run a short token-level latency dashboard during the spike to watch tail percentiles.

Logistics notes:
- Jasmine will lead the prompt review and walk through prompt-family test cases.
- Marissa will own the load plan + orchestration on our side and coordinate fallback lanes.
- We will need staging API keys and a read-only view into your routing rules (or a document that lists buckets) — if SSO is required, loop in your SSO team.

Attachments: POC-runbook-v1.pdf, timezone-rehearsal-grid.xlsx

Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Park <acme-poc@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — availability and rehearsal

Looping Rishi for infra/latency SLOs. A couple of practical adjustments from our side:

- If we do Option A (early window), EU participants will be late evening — that’s fine, but APAC will be after midnight. We propose a rotating rehearsal cadence: this week we cover an early-US window (Option A) and next week we run an APAC-friendly slot so they're not always late.

- Load plan adjustment: start with a smaller spike (80 RPS) for the first rehearsal to validate model-serving paths, then escalate to the 120 RPS stress run in a follow-up rehearsal. That gives us a safe canary.

- Routing handoff: Alicia — can you share a short doc (1–2 bullets) of the routing predicates you want exercised? e.g., by customer tier / country / feature-flag state. If you cannot share, we can run synthetic buckets that simulate those predicates.

I’ll prep the orchestration plan and a quick turnaround checklist.

Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference

Thanks Marissa — we can do Option A on Tue morning PST. Quick clarifications:

- Routing predicates: we can provide a redacted doc with country and plan-level buckets (will share by EOD Monday).
- Staging keys: SSO Team — can you provision a staging API access account scoped to read/write for the rehearsal? We’ll need the credentials and a short access checklist.

I dropped the SSO contact in CC — thanks in advance.

Perfect — attaching a calendar ICS and the updated POC runbook that includes a canary escalation plan and rollback play. Brief rundown for tomorrow:

- 08:30 PST: Prompt review (Jasmine) — focus on prompt families A/B/C, guardrails, and expected token counts.
- 09:00 PST: Short break, quick config check.
- 09:15 PST: Load rehearsal (Marissa) — ramp to 80 RPS; we’ll run a 10-minute sustain and a 30-second spike to 120 RPS as a validation if all looks healthy.
- During the run we’ll monitor: token latency p50/p95/p99, KV cache hit-rate, and per-route cost estimate.
